column1: ; The plot items of the Ring: the items a scenario author picks from to make a plot item of the scenario,
; The author gives a plot item its name, description and comment, which the scenario holds; the sheet gives
; the icon, and what every plot item is: an item of the family scroll R2, 99 to a stack, bulk and weight 1,
; not saleable (generate_sitem.py). They differ in their icon only.
; A scenario holds the number of the sheet (sheet_id.bin), and the scenario service takes r2_plot_item_0 to
; r2_plot_item_184 by name: item N keeps its number and its icon, so that a scenario shows the item its
; author picked. Do not renumber or reorder the icons.
; The textures are named as the interface atlas of the client lists them (texture_interfaces_*.txt).
; r2_plot_item_74: no client data has a texture of this name, so the client shows its default item icon
; (item_default) for it, as it always has. By its place in the list (the icons are in the order of their
; names) and by the name it has here, it was meant to be the dry wood icon, whose texture name has a space
; in it ("mp_dry wood"): the client reads a name of its atlas table up to the first space, so it has no
; texture of that name either. To give the item its icon the texture needs a name without a space first.
; The icon of the slot that creates a new plot item. Not a plot item: its name does not have r2_plot_item
; in it, which is what the client goes by to list the items to pick from.
